title: Gated audit-log retention SKUs and compliance-onboarding path
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Background: Enterprise customers increasingly demand both longer audit-log retention and tighter controls on who can access that data. We currently offer observability retention tiers and a separate compliance add-on process; customers and sales are asking for a gated, contract-backed SKU that bundles extended audit retention, an enterprise-grade compliance questionnaire flow, and an optional premium SLA upgrade. Proposal: Create a gated add-on SKU (Audit+ Compliance Tier) that pairs extended log retention (90/365/730 days) with an entitlement flow that requires a completed security questionnaire and contract attachment for activation. Include an in-console activation wizard for Sales/CS to confirm eligibility and attach the contract, with automatic billing change and optional SLA upgrade path. This ticket scopes the PM work: pricing guardrails, onboarding flow copy and UX hooks, acceptance criteria, and rollout plan. Engineering and Legal will own enforcement and contract templates respectively.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Product defines 3 Audit+ retention SKUs and clear pricing increments. 2) In-console activation wizard exists that: a) validates questionnaire completion, b) captures contract upload/attachment metadata, c) triggers entitlement flag in tenant metadata. 3) Billing system creates a prorated invoice change and updates tenant billing plan. 4) Access gating is enforced: only tenants with entitlement flag can enable >30 days retention. 5) Sales/CS can create a temporary trial entitlement (14d) via console. 6) Documentation and security questionnaire template published to Confluence. 7) Security review sign-off obtained.
success_metrics: - Number of customers converting to Audit+ within first quarter >= 6. - Average revenue per customer (ARPC) uplift from customers who adopt Audit+ >= $3k ARR. - Reduction in manual contract onboarding cases by 70% within 6 weeks. - Time-to-enable for qualified customers < 48 hours (end-to-end, including contract attachment).
implementation_notes: Engineering owners: ENG infra team for entitlement flags and billing hooks; ENG-observability for retention enforcement. Legal: prepare contract addendum and data processing addendum language. Design: create activation wizard UI and Sales/CS admin controls. Dependencies: existing billing API changes (ENG-50321) and console entitlement UI library (PM-83100). Use feature-flag for gradual rollout. Build telemetry events: entitlement.requested, entitlement.activated, entitlement.trial_created, retention.usage_change.
rollout_plan: 1) Alpha: internal Sales/CS + 2 pilot customers (2 weeks) behind feature flag. 2) Beta: expand to 10 invited customers, collect feedback, finalize pricing (4 weeks). 3) GA: enable self-serve activation for eligible customers with contract attachment flow and billing update (after Legal sign-off and SLA doc published). Communication: customer-facing blog + product changelog + sales enablement deck.
risks: - Legal review may require changes to contract language, delaying GA. - Billing proration edge-cases for committed reserved capacity customers. - Performance or storage cost unexpectedly higher for long-tail retention (cost modeling required). - Possible confusion if entitlement flags are out-of-sync (we must implement idempotent reconciliation job).
open_questions: Do we allow trial entitlements for customers on Dedicated/Private (air-gapped)?
What SLAs do we attach to the premium SLA upgrade (RTO/RPO targets)?
Should extended retention be available per-route or company-wide only?
